management.note: MgmtCo has 17.25% of SVF2 LLC Equity, subordinate to SBG Preferred Equity. Distributions have fund-wide 130%-200% hurdles and receivable offsets. This is not a 17.25% interest in every gross investment. Exact incremental shareholder allocation cannot be reproduced from these aggregate disclosures.

assumptions.note: Management sensitivity deducts 0%-17.25% of positive post-June OpenAI revaluation excluding new invested capital; default is the larger deduction. This bracket is not a confidence interval or full fund waterfall. Tax is optional and uses an adjustable, unverified Arm basis proxy. Other net-debt adjustment is an explicit unresolved bridge; zero is not a claim of no subsequent cash flows.
